children: Overview
Hong Kong fast food operator's interim revenue fell 1% yr/yr to HK$3,995 mln
Profit attributable to shareholders rose 117% yr/yr, driven by cost and operational efficiency
Company repurchased HK$50 mln in shares during the period
Outlook
Cafe De Coral plans to optimise operational and cost efficiency through business model innovation and supply chain integration
Company to expand reach in Hong Kong with high-value, health-focused menu and product innovation
Result Drivers
COST CONTROL AND EFFICIENCY - Co said improved gross margin and profit were due to direct cost control, operational efficiency, and supply chain improvements
STORE NETWORK OPTIMISATION - Co trimmed underperforming outlets and rebalanced geographic presence, which reduced rental costs and supported profitability
DIGITAL AND MARKETING INITIATIVES - Co used AI-powered customer analytics, targeted promotions, and loyalty programs to boost customer retention and sales quality
